user.description: Choose the meter to set up. It must be switched on and within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.

abort.no_devices_found: No SoilX meter found. Wake the meter (it switches itself off after a few minutes on battery; it stays on while charging) and close the phone app, which blocks other connections.
abort.already_configured: This meter is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Set-up of this meter is already in progress.

init.description: The meter allows one Bluetooth connection at a time, so Home Assistant connects, reads and disconnects.
